Nora Feldman: opened a PR to harmonize audit-log wording around key ownership and retention examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1175
Diego Ramos: noted two user reports: (1) examples referencing GCP key paths confused AWS customers, (2) retention example saying '7 years' was flagged by sales as too prescriptive.
Nora Feldman: propose: first mention use 'customer-managed key (CMK) — e.g., KMS or HSM', then CMK thereafter. For examples, use a neutral placeholder: PROJECT/REGION/KEY_RING/KEY.
Priya Reddy: agree. Also add SDK-version labels to snippets (Python v1.x, Go v0.x, CLI v2) so customers know what to copy.
Ola Svensson (Legal): legal guidance: prefer non-prescriptive retention language. Suggest: 'Hosted default retention: 1 year; configurable by contract or retention policy; follow applicable laws.' Add: 'This page is informational and not legal advice.'
